architecture.parent_policy: accepted Neural vNext Native R3 attributed-belief policy, frozen

candidate must solve strictly more total dev episodes than frozen R3
conditional_regimes, regime_switch and causal_prerequisites solved counts must equal frozen R3 exactly
among eligible candidates maximize implicit_goal_regimes solved
